name: get_hottest
description: Get trending stories from Lobsters. Returns title, URL, score, comment count, and tags for each story.

name: get_newest
description: Get latest stories posted to Lobsters. Returns title, URL, publication time, score, and tags for each story.

name: get_story
description: Fetch a single story and all its comments by ID (e.g., "abc123"). Returns title, URL, text, score, and nested comment threads.

short_id.description: The short alphanumeric story ID from the Lobsters URL (e.g. "abcdef")

name: get_tag
description: Search stories by tag (e.g., "rust", "programming", "security"). Returns matching stories with titles, URLs, scores, and tags.
